note: Phase 2 / Part A: two variants of round 1d's pumpkin, both inside the constraint (a round silhouette, one sheet, holes cut through as the only device). 1d's edge, nose and banded mouth reused verbatim where stated. The maintainer chooses by looking at the captures.

sprites.name: moon_jack_o_lantern (minimal)
sprites.notes: Round 1d's edge, nose and banded mouth with four fangs, unchanged. ONLY the eyes change: a wedge cut by hand (six vertices, +/-1.5), tall on the outside and narrow towards the nose, a brow sloping down towards the nose. Mean of the opaque pixels 244.1.

sprites.name: moon_jack_o_lantern (pushed)
sprites.notes: The same edge and nose as 1d. Three pushes inside the disc: wedge eyes with a steeper brow; a saw-toothed grin (a single hole, 38..202, three fangs from the upper lip and two from the lower lip, staggered, corners rising); four tapered ribs cut into the high crown of the disc. Mean of the opaque pixels 244.1.
